id: Danger Close: The Battle of Long Tan (2019)

facts.text: Eat up, men. Delta Company has a long day ahead, and the rain won't help us.
facts.why: Reads as Major Harry Smith's own words, a real officer. No quote like it is on any page opened, and the one Smith line found is a short, sharp reply to the order to withdraw. The film has no mess tent speech in the plot.
facts.fix: Delta Company is relieving Bravo at the rubber plantation today. Eat while it's hot.

fix_note.text: Delta Company is relieving Bravo at the rubber plantation today. Eat while it's hot.

facts.text: three days' leave down at Vung Tau
facts.why: No source opened mentions Vung Tau leave in the film.
facts.fix: a hot plate before the long patrol

facts.why: The timeline row '0900 Long Tan rubber plantation' and the '12:46 chow' slot are not confirmed. The plot only says Delta Company is sent the day after Bravo, and the fighting is that afternoon in heavy rain.

vibe.verdict: A tidy mess tent with the Nui Dat concert and the 108 men right, but it skips almost every part of the battle and the signed note is made up for a real officer.
missing: Private Large firing his weapon during the mortar attack, then killed at the end
11 Platoon radioing artillery to land 'danger close'
The two RAAF Iroquois pilots flying in with ammunition under fire
The roll call of the men who died
Harry Smith refusing to leave 11 Platoon behind and the M113s arriving
Little Pattie's concert going on while D Company is fighting
ideas: Swap 'Ration pack chocolate orange pots' note for 'Danger close', the artillery call on 11 Platoon.
Swap 'Cold can of VB' note for Large's beer during the mortar attack, with a sombre line.
Swap the 'Badge' line for 'Roll call' to end on the names of the men who died.
Swap 'Spam fritters' note for the helicopter resupply in the rain.
